propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for held or orphaned write locks—operators must manually inspect lock directories to determine holder identity and process liveness

The four lock legs (tickets-write-fcntl, tickets-write-mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) must be reported with held/free/absent state, and the mkdir leg must expose holder identity (host/ns/pid/start), liveness, and hold age
Lock staleness determination must be delegated solely to the existing rebar._store.lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale function with no independent heuristics introduced
A stale lock (dead holder) must produce a finding and exit code 1; a held lock with a live holder must produce only INFO and exit 0
rebar doctor must remain read-only over locks—no mutation of lock state, ownership files, or drain lock files during or after execution
